I have farmed this land in Mbeya since I was young and I know what works here. I went to school for a few years so I can read the labels on the bags, and I will buy half a bag of urea for this plot, which is about 20 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare. I also spread manure every season because this land belongs to me, and I plant improved seed because my neighbor got a good harvest from it last year. My family does most of the work, but because I am 76 years old now, I hire a young man from the village for about five days when the land is hard to dig.
